insightUpgrades.name: Engineering heritage
insightUpgrades.description: Double Engineering Progress and Collaboration Credit production and active engineering yield per level.

insightUpgrades.name: Expansive observing
insightUpgrades.description: Double all passive Data and observing assistance per level.

insightUpgrades.name: Clear analysis
insightUpgrades.description: Double passive Knowledge and instant Knowledge per Data per level.

insightUpgrades.name: Shared enthusiasm
insightUpgrades.description: Double Interest and Funding production, including active help, per level.

insightUpgrades.name: Institutional memory
insightUpgrades.description: +20% graduate rewards per level; double Expertise production and Publication production per level. Academy timers stay fixed.

insightUpgrades.name: Connected thinking
insightUpgrades.description: +5% graduate rewards per level; multiply all other production and assistance by 1.25 per level. Academy timers stay fixed.

finale.name: Eyes on the Universe
finale.description: Bring changing-star, planetary-system and early-galaxy research together in one connected view of the universe.

jointPrograms.name: The changing sky
jointPrograms.description: Connect repeated optical brightness measurements with radio timing to study changing sources.

jointPrograms.name: Worlds in context
jointPrograms.description: Combine orbital brightness monitoring and stellar spectra to place planetary-system measurements in context.

jointPrograms.name: Light across time
jointPrograms.description: Combine ground and infrared observing capability in a coordinated early-galaxy research program.

missions.name: Orbital brightness monitoring
missions.description: The first optical orbital telescope repeatedly measures stellar brightness.

missions.name: Infrared flagship survey
missions.description: A separate cooled observatory repeatedly surveys infrared fields.

programs.name: Variable-star photometry study
programs.description: Independent research teams repeatedly study stellar brightness changes. Each team continuously generates Publications with no recurring costs.

stations.name: Backyard observatory
stations.subtitle: 01 · Gather the light
stations.use: Telescopes add capacity. Research unlocks better targets. Every observation contributes to one Data balance.

stations.name: Analysis lab
stations.subtitle: 02 · Scientific understanding
stations.use: Analyze Data for Knowledge now, or invest in permanent income. Knowledge unlocks scientific capabilities and new targets.

stations.name: Outreach
stations.subtitle: 03 · Share the sky
stations.use: Generate community Interest to establish supporter groups and help open the academy.

stations.name: Support office
stations.subtitle: 04 · Build lasting support
stations.use: Funding buys telescopes, equipment, classrooms and research teams. Existing producers have no operating costs.

stations.name: Engineering workshop
stations.subtitle: 05 · Build the next instrument
stations.use: Benches and engineers create Engineering Progress. Spend it once on permanent facilities and instruments. No wages or operating costs.

stations.name: Academy
stations.subtitle: 06 · Teach the next observer
stations.use: Classrooms automatically graduate people every 40 seconds. Add qualified teaching teams for more independent classrooms.

stations.name: Research institute
stations.subtitle: 07 · Institutional expertise
stations.use: Mentoring and researchers build Expertise for required calibration and operations methods, plus station improvements. Target research uses Knowledge in Analysis.

stations.name: Scientific programs
stations.subtitle: 08 · Publish a result
stations.use: Teams continuously generate Publications. Your unspent record qualifies the network for grants, missions and advanced research.

stations.name: Radio observatory
stations.subtitle: 09 · Listen to the sky
stations.use: Radio dishes add another observing wavelength to the shared Data stream. More dishes increase permanent capacity; radio research improves science.

stations.name: Space missions
stations.subtitle: 10 · Beyond the atmosphere
stations.use: Build and commission two distinct telescopes in stages. Each continuously produces Data and Publications. No operating costs; earlier instruments continue.

stations.name: Joint science
stations.subtitle: 11 · Bring the network together
stations.use: Add complementary research teams that continuously earn Collaboration Credits and Publications. Improve the network, then complete its final synthesis.

facilities.name: Backyard observatory
facilities.description: The founding telescope and its growing collection of instruments.

facilities.name: Permanent enclosure
facilities.description: A dedicated home for the existing instruments. +4 base observing capacity.

facilities.name: Robotic dome
facilities.description: A new automated instrument joins the backyard network. +8 base capacity; enables a spectrograph.

facilities.name: Expanded observatory
facilities.description: Two more instruments extend the network. +16 base capacity; enables galaxy imaging.

facilities.name: Mountain observatory
facilities.description: A larger mountain telescope joins every earlier instrument. +32 base capacity; enables galaxy-cluster imaging.

facilities.name: Radio observatory
facilities.description: A radio dish joins the ground network. Optical instruments remain productive.

facilities.name: Orbital observatory network
facilities.description: The first optical telescope observes from orbit alongside the ground network.

facilities.name: Infrared observatory network
facilities.description: The cooled infrared flagship joins the first orbital telescope and all ground instruments.

investments.name: Develop advanced calibration
investments.effect: Qualify at 5 Publications. Expertise enables the spectrograph and mountain telescope.

investments.name: Develop orbital operations
investments.effect: Qualify at 30 Publications. Expertise enables optical payload integration.

investments.name: Develop infrared calibration
investments.effect: Qualify at 1,000 Publications. Expertise enables the flagship mirror and payload.

investments.name: Develop network integration
investments.effect: Qualify at 1,000 Publications. Integrate the network for the final synthesis.

investments.name: Qualify for research grants
investments.effect: A record of 15 Publications opens research grants: 4 base Funding/s each.

investments.name: Secure research grant
investments.effect: Use one shared Publication-backed grant slot for 4 base Funding/s. Publications are never spent.

investments.name: Qualify for flagship grants
investments.effect: A record of 100 Publications opens flagship grants: 8 base Funding/s each.

investments.name: Secure flagship grant
investments.effect: Use one shared Publication-backed grant slot for 8 base Funding/s. Prices grow 80%; no upkeep.

investments.name: Appoint science coordinator
investments.effect: Permanently appoint one graduate: +25% of base Collaboration Credit production.

investments.name: Open joint science center
investments.effect: Connect the network through three complementary programs. Add permanent teams to increase continuous output.

investments.name: Add changing-sky team
investments.effect: Ground photometry + radio timing: Each team adds 0.017 base Collaboration Credits/s and 0.033 base Publications/s. Prices grow 60%.

investments.name: Add planetary-systems team
investments.effect: Orbital monitoring + stellar spectra: Each team adds 0.033 base Credits/s and 0.05 base Publications/s. Prices grow 60%.

investments.name: Add deep-time team
investments.effect: Mountain + infrared observations: Each team adds 0.05 base Credits/s and 0.067 base Publications/s. Prices grow 60%.

investments.name: Improve collaboration practice
investments.effect: +50% of base Collaboration Credits per second.

investments.name: Coordinate observing network
investments.effect: +50% of base Data output across the whole network, including observing assistance.

investments.name: Build shared analysis catalog
investments.effect: +100% of base Knowledge income and instant Knowledge per Data.

investments.name: Share instrument development
investments.effect: +50% of base Engineering income and active development yield.

investments.name: Coordinate scientific analysis
investments.effect: +50% of base Publication production across ground teams, space missions and joint programs. Production is continuous.

investments.name: Complete final network synthesis
investments.effect: Combine all three programs, network integration and 5,000 Publications. Pay the resources to complete the prototype immediately.

investments.name: Build radio observatory
investments.effect: Add the first radio dish and 24 base Data capacity. A new observing wavelength; all optical instruments continue.

investments.name: Add radio dish
investments.effect: Add 12 base Data capacity per dish. Prices grow 60%; no upkeep or telescope reassignment.

investments.name: Develop radio timing
investments.effect: Add radio timing measurements: +50% of base Publication production per second.

investments.name: Research radio sources
investments.effect: Extend the network frontier from ×21 to ×34. Radio opens another way to observe the sky.

investments.name: Establish space program
investments.effect: Open staged construction of the first optical orbital telescope. Existing observatories keep working.

investments.name: Build orbital platform
investments.effect: Complete the first spacecraft platform. Install its optical payload next; observing starts after commissioning.

investments.name: Install optical payload
investments.effect: Complete the optical instrument. Launch and commission the telescope to begin automatic observing.

investments.name: Launch and commission orbital telescope
investments.effect: Add 48 base Data capacity. Start continuous orbital science at 0.017 base Publications/s.

investments.name: Develop orbital monitoring
investments.effect: Add sustained orbital brightness measurements: +50% of base Publication production per second.

investments.name: Research transit targets
investments.effect: Extend the frontier from ×34 to ×55 through brightness monitoring of transit targets. No claim of life detection.

investments.name: Establish infrared flagship program
investments.effect: Begin a separate infrared mission at 1,000 Publications. The first mission continues.

investments.name: Build flagship mirror and payload
investments.effect: Assemble the infrared instrument. Complete thermal shielding before commissioning.

investments.name: Install flagship thermal shield
investments.effect: Complete thermal shielding for the cooled infrared observatory. Commission the distinct flagship next.

investments.name: Launch and commission infrared flagship
investments.effect: Add 96 base Data capacity and continuous science at 0.033 base Publications/s. Earlier missions continue.

investments.name: Research infrared fields
investments.effect: Extend the frontier from ×55 to ×89 with infrared observing capability.

investments.name: Research early-galaxy deep fields
investments.effect: Extend the frontier from ×89 to ×144 at 3,000 Publications. Study early galaxies; the Big Bang is not directly imaged.

investments.name: Open engineering workshop
investments.effect: Establish the founding bench: +0.15 base Engineering Progress/s. No operating costs.

investments.name: Add engineering bench
investments.effect: Add 0.25 base Engineering Progress/s permanently. Prices grow 50% per bench.

investments.name: Appoint engineer
investments.effect: One permanent graduate adds 0.5 base Engineering Progress/s. Funding price grows 50%; no wages.

investments.name: Improve engineering practice
investments.effect: +50% of base Engineering Progress income and instrument-development assistance.

investments.name: Build permanent enclosure
investments.effect: Add 4 base observing capacity with permanent housing for the instruments. All earlier production continues.

investments.name: Build robotic dome
investments.effect: Add an automated telescope and 8 base observing capacity. Enables spectrograph development.

investments.name: Expand observatory network
investments.effect: Add two instruments and 16 base observing capacity. Enables galaxy imaging research.

investments.name: Build mountain telescope
investments.effect: Add a mountain instrument and 32 base observing capacity. Enables galaxy-cluster imaging; all earlier telescopes remain.

investments.name: Develop spectrograph
investments.effect: Add the instrument capability needed for stellar spectroscopy in Scientific programs.

investments.name: Develop stellar spectroscopy
investments.effect: Add spectral measurements to brightness studies: +100% of base Publications per second.

investments.name: Research galaxy imaging
investments.effect: Extend the observing frontier from ×8 to ×13. Every retained producer benefits.

investments.name: Research galaxy-cluster imaging
investments.effect: Extend the observing frontier from ×13 to ×21. Completes the ground-observatory prototype frontier.

investments.name: Develop photometry
investments.effect: Establish the founding research team: 0.017 base Publications/s, continuously.

investments.name: Open grant office
investments.effect: Unlock grant purchases. Each Publication supports one grant; Publications are never spent.

investments.name: Secure observing grant
investments.effect: Add recurring Funding with no upkeep. Uses one Publication-backed grant slot for this run.

investments.name: Establish research team
investments.effect: One graduate establishes another team producing 0.017 base Publications/s. Stock prices grow 60% per team; no upkeep.

investments.name: Improve scientific practice
investments.effect: +50% of base Publications per second.

investments.name: Establish observing routine
investments.effect: Automates the founding telescope: +1 base observing capacity.

investments.name: Open basic analysis
investments.effect: Unlock instant analysis, archive research and target discoveries.

investments.name: Expand archive research
investments.effect: Permanent Knowledge income. Pay Data once; no continuing Data drain.

investments.name: Research Jupiter observations
investments.effect: Raise the observing frontier from ×1 to ×2. All installed capacity and active observing benefit.

investments.name: Open outreach
investments.effect: Unlock sharing the sky and standing outreach activities.

investments.name: Add outreach activity
investments.effect: Permanent Interest income. Other stations keep their full production.

investments.name: Open support office
investments.effect: Unlock supporter groups and Funding actions.

investments.name: Add supporter group
investments.effect: Permanent Funding income. Spending Interest never removes existing supporters.

investments.name: Add observing telescope
investments.effect: Add 2 base observing capacity. Every target and equipment bonus applies.

investments.name: Install stable mount
investments.effect: +25% of base observing output, including active help.

investments.name: Install motorized tracking
investments.effect: Open tracked observing methods and the reflector path.

investments.name: Research Saturn observations
investments.effect: Raise the observing frontier from ×2 to ×3, permanently.

investments.name: Build 150–200 mm reflector
investments.effect: Add 4 base observing capacity and enable camera equipment. All earlier telescopes remain productive.

investments.name: Install imaging camera
investments.effect: +50% of base observing output; enables imaging research.

investments.name: Research stellar-cluster imaging
investments.effect: Raise the observing frontier from ×3 to ×5 and reveal the academy.

investments.name: Research nebula imaging
investments.effect: Raise Data yield from ×5 to ×8; enables observatory expansion and prestige eligibility.

investments.name: Install analysis workstation
investments.effect: +100% of base Knowledge income and instant analysis yield.

investments.name: Improve outreach materials
investments.effect: +50% of base passive Interest and Share the sky yield per level.

investments.name: Improve supporter appeals
investments.effect: +50% of base Funding income and Contact supporters yield per level.

investments.name: Open academy
investments.effect: Establish the founding classroom: one base graduate every 40 seconds, automatically.

investments.name: Establish research institute
investments.effect: The first mentoring program generates Expertise for advanced methods and station improvements.

investments.name: Add mentoring program
investments.effect: Permanent Expertise income. No recurring costs or staff transfers.

investments.name: Develop teaching qualification
investments.effect: Unassigned graduates can become permanent teachers.

investments.name: Improve observing practice
investments.effect: +25% of base Data output, including active help.

investments.name: Improve analysis practice
investments.effect: +50% of base Knowledge income and instant analysis yield.

investments.name: Improve teaching practice
investments.effect: +25% of base graduates per completed cycle. Timers stay at 40 seconds.

investments.name: Appoint observer
investments.effect: Permanent appointment: add 2 observing capacity across the current and all future frontiers.

investments.name: Appoint analyst
investments.effect: Permanent appointment: add Knowledge production. No Data drain.

investments.name: Appoint educator
investments.effect: Permanent appointment: add Interest production for supporter groups.

investments.name: Appoint fundraiser
investments.effect: Permanent appointment: add Funding production. No wages.

investments.name: Establish teaching team
investments.effect: One qualified graduate establishes another independent 40-second classroom. Stock prices triple per team; no upkeep.

investments.name: Appoint researcher
investments.effect: Permanent appointment: add institutional Expertise production.
